title: F-Q7: clientUri derived from leaf signature key (INVENTED)
description: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. clientUri = mimi://<domain>/d/<base32(SHA-256(leaf signature key))>; stable because a mimi-mls Identity uses one signature key for all its KeyPackages. Add to wg mimid-1wgh.37.67. Approved by Mark 2026-10-18 (plan .7).
notes:
Encoding confirmed by Mark 2026-10-18: clientUri = mimi://<our domain>/d/<lowercase RFC 4648 base32 without padding of SHA-256(leaf signature key)>.
2026-10-18: bead text 'mimi:///d/' is shorthand; code (follower/key_packages.rs:116-125) is mimi://<provider domain>/d/<base32>. Mark: keep it implementation-defined; do not write it into jmap-chat-mimi-00.
2026-10-19 assay of identity-05: mimi://<domain>/d/<id> matches identity-05's Client form 'mimi://a.example/d/ClientA1' (Table 3, L419-420); no conflict.
